_meta.anthropic/searchHint: device simulator emulator chromium screen image capture baseline tvos apple tv

description:
Capture a PNG of the device screen (iOS simulator or physical device, Android emulator, Apple TV simulator, Vega, or Chromium app). Returns { image }, the PNG file.
Use when you need a baseline image before an interaction or the screen state after a delay. Gestures, key presses and app launches already attach a screenshot to their result.
Fails if the capture backend (simulator-server, emulator, Chromium CDP) cannot be reached for this device.

downscaler.description: Downscaling algorithm when scale<1 on Chromium. Defaults to lanczos3 (highest quality). Ignored on every other platform.

includeImageInContext.description: Set false only when capturing a full-resolution PNG (scale: 1.0) to save as a baseline/current for screenshot-diff. The file is still written, but the image bytes are not attached to the agent context. Default: true.

rotation.description: Orientation override for the screenshot (on Chromium it rotates the captured image). On Android the capture already follows the device's rotation. Ignored on physical iPhones.

scale.description: Scale factor. Defaults to ARGENT_SCREENSHOT_SCALE env var, or 0.25 if unset for iOS/Android. On a local Apple TV simulator, an Android TV or Vega, with neither set, the capture is downscaled to a 576 px long side (0.15 of a 4K capture). On Chromium the default is 1.0 (no downscale); pass <1 to opt in. Downscaling on Chromium requires the optional `sharp` dependency. Range: 0.01 to 1.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID, Android serial, Apple TV UDID, Vega serial, or Chromium id).

name: screenshot
